typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Archive_Folder_Path as string (),
	DBPassword as string (),
	DBServerName as string (),
	DHCS_Email_Recipients as string (),
	DHCS_FileName as string (),
	DHCS_Outbound_Folder_Path as string (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	Failure_Email_Recipients as string (),
	File_Type as string (),
	InitialCatalog as string (),
	LAC_FileName as string (),
	LAC_Outbound_Folder_Path as string (),
	LA_Care_Email_Recipients as string (),
	Reporting_Period as string (),
	RowCountLACare as integer (),
	Rpt_Recipient as string (),
	TemplateFile as string (),
	TemplateFileFolder as string (),
	TemplateFileName as string (),
	UserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		planCode as string,
		cin as string,
		subnetwork as string,
		providerGroupName as string,
		providerGroupNpi as string,
		providerGroupTaxId as string,
		siteNpi as string,
		providerNpi as string,
		assignmentLevel as string,
		ReportYrMo as string,
		submittingEntity as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @P_reportingPeriod VARCHAR(20) = ? DECLARE @File_Type Varchar(100) = ?    DECLARE @P_ReportYrMo  VARCHAR(20) = (SELECT MAX(SubmissionYearMonth) FROM Data_Exchange.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_LOG   									  WHERE reportingPeriod = @P_reportingPeriod AND FILE_TYPE = @File_Type)  DECLARE @P_submittingEntity VARCHAR(100) = (SELECT MAX(submittingEntity) FROM Data_Exchange.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_LOG                                          WHERE reportingPeriod = @P_reportingPeriod AND FILE_TYPE = @File_Type)  SELECT  planCode ,cin ,subnetwork ,providerGroupName ,providerGroupNpi ,providerGroupTaxId ,siteNpi ,providerNpi ,assignmentLevel ,@P_ReportYrMo AS ReportYrMo ,@P_submittingEntity AS submittingEntity FROM Data_Exchange.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_PCPA_EXTRACTWHERE  ISNULL(PlanCode,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(CIN,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(subnetwork,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(providerGroupName,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(ProviderGroupNPI,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(providerGroupTaxId,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(siteNPI,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(PlanCode,\'\')=\'304\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceQueryforLACare	source(output(
		submittingEntity as string,
		planParent as string,
		reportingPeriod as string,
		schemaVersion as string,
		submissionDate as string,
		submissionType as string,
		submissionVersion as string,
		SubmissionYearMonth as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @P_reportingPeriod VARCHAR(20) = ? DECLARE @File_Type Varchar(100) = ?  DECLARE @P_Excel_FileName  VARCHAR(100) = (SELECT MAX(Excel_FileName ) FROM Data_Exchange.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_LOG WHERE reportingPeriod = @P_reportingPeriod AND FILE_TYPE = @File_Type)  SELECT  planParent  , reportingPeriod  , schemaVersion , submissionDate  , submissionType , submissionVersion ,    submittingEntity , SubmissionYearMonth FROM Data_Exchange.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_LOG WHERE Excel_FileName= @P_Excel_FileName',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceQueryforLACare1
SourceQueryforLACare derive({Copy of providerGroupTaxId} = providerGroupTaxId,
		{Copy of cin} = cin,
		{Copy of planCode} = planCode,
		{Copy of submittingEntity} = submittingEntity,
		{Copy of subnetwork} = subnetwork,
		{Copy of siteNpi} = siteNpi,
		{Copy of providerGroupName} = providerGroupName,
		{Copy of providerNpi} = providerNpi,
		{Copy of providerGroupNpi} = providerGroupNpi,
		{Copy of assignmentLevel} = assignmentLevel,
		{Copy of ReportYrMo} = ReportYrMo) ~> DataConversion
SourceQueryforLACare1 derive({Copy of reportingPeriod} = reportingPeriod,
		{Copy of submissionType} = submissionType,
		{Copy of schemaVersion} = schemaVersion,
		{Copy of submissionDate} = submissionDate,
		{Copy of SubmissionYearMonth} = SubmissionYearMonth,
		{Copy of submittingEntity} = submittingEntity,
		{Copy of submissionVersion} = submissionVersion,
		{Copy of planParent} = planParent) ~> DataConversion1
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of providerGroupNpi} as string,
		{Copy of submittingEntity} as string,
		{Copy of planCode} as string,
		{Copy of providerGroupTaxId} as string,
		{Copy of providerNpi} as string,
		{Copy of providerGroupName} as string,
		{Copy of subnetwork} as string,
		{Copy of cin} as string,
		{Copy of siteNpi} as string,
		{Copy of ReportYrMo} as string,
		{Copy of assignmentLevel} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestinationPCPASheet
DataConversion aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
DataConversion1 sink(input(
		{Copy of submissionType} as string,
		{Copy of submittingEntity} as string,
		{Copy of submissionVersion} as string,
		{Copy of SubmissionYearMonth} as string,
		{Copy of reportingPeriod} as string,
		{Copy of schemaVersion} as string,
		{Copy of submissionDate} as string,
		{Copy of planParent} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestinationPCPAHeader
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
